about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm Soulaimane. I've just finished a Higher Certificate in Web Application Development (DAW) at Ins Camí de Mar, and I'm looking for my first job as a developer.

At Synkiria I automated real processes with n8n and Odoo: things that used to be done by hand started doing themselves. That's where I learned that writing code is easy — making it keep working for months is the hard part.
I also build websites for local businesses: something clear, readable on a phone, and live without any hassle.
I like understanding how things work on the inside and leaving them running, not just working on my own laptop.
